title: Garth Brooks, Riley Green, Zach Top to Headline Stagecoach 2027: ‘A Guaranteed Good Time’
summary: The festival is slated for April 2027.
contentText:
Riley Green , Zach Top and Garth Brooks will spearheading the annual Stagecoach country music festival when it returns to Indio, California’s Empire Polo Club on April 23-25, 2027, helping to bring country music fans three days of genre-spanning music in the California desert.

Others on the lineup include artists across country, rock, pop, Latin and reggae, such as HARDY, Turnpike Troubadours, Charley Crockett, Jo Dee Messina, Kaitlin Butts, Willie Nelson & Family, Kelly Clarkson, Brothers Osborne, Shaboozey, Dasha, Stella Lefty, Stephen Wilson Jr, Journey, Pitbull, Carín León, Matchbox Twenty and Cameron Whitcomb.

Additionally, Florida Georgia Line will make a special late-night set, marking the reunited duo’s first officially announced performance since teasing their reunion earlier this year. The Late Night on Mustang Stage will also feature performances from Sean Paul and Flo Rida. Diplo’s HonkyTonk will return, as will Guy Fieri’s Stagecoach Smokehouse.

“The last time we played Stagecoach was back in 2018, and a whole lot of life has happened since then,” Florida Georgia Line said in a statement. “There’s something really special about getting to come back to the desert together, step on that stage again, and share these songs and memories with the fans who have been with us through it all. We couldn’t think of a better place to do it.”

Green, who’s 2026 Stagecoach set was nixed due to an emergency evacuation and high winds at the festival, said of his upcoming 2027 performance, “Let’s do this again. We’re excited to make it back out to the desert after a wild ride last year. We’ll probably stay all weekend and catch the other sets so come join us.”

Top added, “When we played Stagecoach in 2024, it was one of the very first festivals where we really drew a crowd for our set. We packed out the Palomino stage and I remember feeling like we were really doing something. Now to be back in 2027 as a headliner is just something truly special.”

“Stagecoach is a guaranteed good time,” Brooks said. “I was shocked by how personal everything there is … from the people working the venue to the people singing along. A MUST if you’re a Country music fan!”

Tickets for the 2027 Stagecoach festival will go on sale starting Friday, Sept. 18, at 11 a.m. PT on the festival’s website . Payment plans will also be offered at $49 down.

Amazon Music also returns as Stagecoach’s exclusive livestream destination for the fifth consecutive year. Fans can livestream performances on Amazon Music, Prime Video, Twitch, Amazon Live and the Amazon Music app on Fire TV.
